title: Standard test game 3: tower defense
prompt: Make a Roblox tower-defense game for ages 8 to 14, one map. Enemies follow a waypoint path from a spawner to the player base. 10 waves with at least 3 enemy types (fast, tank, flying or armoured). 3 tower types (single target, area, slow) that the player buys with coins earned from kills and places on a grid of valid tower pads (snapped, no placing on the path or on another tower), upgrades once each, and can sell. Base health, wave counter and coin HUD, a start-wave button, win screen after wave 10 and a loss screen when base health reaches 0, then restart. It must be playable on phone and desktop. Name the models so a scan can find them: Spawn, Base, Waypoint_<n>, TowerPad_<n>, Tower_<kind>_<n>, Enemy_<kind>. No purchases, no pay-to-win. Report when it is playable; do not call it done unless the gates pass.

features.text: enemies follow waypoints from spawner to base without getting stuck or cutting corners
10 waves, scaling difficulty, 3 or more enemy types with different behaviour
3 tower types with different roles (single, area, slow) that actually do what they say
towers snap to valid pads, cannot be placed on path or on another tower, rotate to face the path
coins from kills, buy/upgrade/sell, costs balanced so all 3 types are used
base health, wave counter, coins, start-wave button, readable on phone
win after wave 10, loss at 0 base health, restart works
tower fire effects, enemy hit/death feedback, damage numbers or health bars
enemy and tower logic runs on the server; placement requests validated
no frame-rate collapse at the largest wave (enemy count capped, pooling or cleanup)

scan_points.text: 3 or more placed towers in the scan (place at least one of each type before scanning)

anchors.3: enemies stuck, towers do nothing, waves cannot be completed
anchors.7: all 10 waves complete, win and loss screens work, restart works
anchors.9: as 7 plus no console errors across a full run

anchors.3: one tower type wins everything or the game is unwinnable
anchors.7: each tower type has a role; mixing is needed from wave 6; winnable but not trivial
anchors.9: as 7 plus a simulation of the economy and a meaningful upgrade choice

anchors.3: towers float, sink, overlap pads or face away from the path
anchors.7: placement gate passes: grounded, upright, facing the path, snapped, no overlap
anchors.9: as 7 plus placement preview/ghost with valid/invalid colour

anchors.7: map has a theme with path, pads and props distinct; towers and enemies are multi-part models
anchors.9: could sit beside front-page tower defense games

anchors.3: no shot effects, no hit reaction
anchors.7: projectiles/beams, hit flash, death effect, wave-start banner, sounds
anchors.9: as 7 plus camera shake on base hit and satisfying kill chains

anchors.3: controls overlap, buttons tiny, tower menu unusable on phone
anchors.7: clean at phone size, tap to select pad/tower, text >= 14 px
anchors.9: as 7 plus drag-to-place with a thumb-safe layout

anchors.3: errors, leaks, FPS collapse at wave 10
anchors.7: server-authoritative logic, validated placement remotes, enemy cleanup, stable FPS
anchors.9: as 7 plus pooling and a stress test with the cap raised
